metadata.title: Backwards compatibility is broken between 1.9.1 and nightly for torch.cosine_similarity

bug_description: torch.cosine_similarity accepted tensors with different numbers of dimensions in PyTorch 1.9.1, but the behavior changed in a nightly version where the same input caused a RuntimeError.

shape: Input tensors have different numbers of dimensions
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.cosine_similarity with tensors whose dimensions require broadcasting

failure_behavior.description: RuntimeError: cosine_similarity requires both inputs to have the same number of dimensions

root_cause_information.description: The bug is related to changed validation behavior for tensor dimension compatibility.

fix_information.fix_description: Behavior compatibility issue was addressed in PyTorch development.
